_description: Typical valence values for common elements in molecular structures
_note: These are the most common valence states. Some elements can have variable valency.

_comments.N: Typically 3 (sp3, sp2, sp) but can form 4 bonds in ammonium
_comments.O: Typically 2 (sp3, sp2) but can have 1 in radicals or peroxides
_comments.S: Can have valency 2, 4, or 6 depending on oxidation state
_comments.C: Always 4 in organic molecules (sp3, sp2, sp)
